description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component called DynamicAsyncImage, which loads an image asynchronously from a URL and displays a placeholder and a progress indicator while loading. It handles loading and error states, applies theme-based tint to the image, and is used within an Android app's design system.

methods.name: DynamicAsyncImage
methods.description: A composable function that displays an image from a URL with loading and error handling, theme tinting, and placeholder support.
